ideas.pitch: A real-time execution visualizer for C++ and Python algorithms that tracks step counts, memory allocations, and loop invariants to help competitive programmers debug Time Limit Exceeded (TLE) errors.
ideas.title: Algorithmic Complexity Visualizer and Speed Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to the ICPC-style competitive programming focus of the event by addressing the exact pain points judges and participants face during timed algorithmic contests.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven stress-testing tool that takes a correct brute-force solution and an optimized candidate solution in C++ or Java, automatically generating adversarial edge-case test inputs to catch wrong answers.
ideas.title: CP-Arena Automated Testcase Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a critical workflow bottleneck in competitive programming contests where participants struggle to find counterexamples for failing algorithms.

ideas.title: Memory Footprint Profiler for C and C++
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates deep systems-level engineering capability, aligning with the algorithmic efficiency and optimization core criteria of the event.

ideas.pitch: A dashboard analyzing historical contest data to recommend optimal problem-solving sequences and time-allocation strategies based on individual team skill profiles during 3-hour timed sprints.
ideas.title: Contest Strategy and Problem Prioritization Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages data-driven strategy to solve the meta-problem of contest time management, making it highly relatable and practical for every competing team.
